subject.title: fix: honor configured default agent across main paths

question: Should OpenClaw accept this broad default-agent path fix as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90573 after the audit dedupe, or defer to a narrower secrets-only path?
rationale: The patch is largely mechanical, but it intentionally changes compatibility-sensitive default-agent storage, session, setup, audit, and auth/model discovery behavior that automation cannot accept for maintainers.

options.title: Land broad fix after audit dedupe
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix, apply the duplicate audit scope cleanup, and make the compatibility impact explicit in merge or release context.

options.title: Prefer the secrets-only subset
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90603 as the narrower storage-scan path and leave session/setup/audit/delivery cleanup for separate owner-reviewed work.

options.title: Pause for upgrade design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether changing default-agent storage paths needs doctor migration or stronger upgrade UX.

recommendation.title: Land broad fix after audit dedupe
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix, apply the duplicate audit scope cleanup, and make the compatibility impact explicit in merge or release context.

likelyOwner.reason: thomasxm authored the prior merged session-key canonicalization fix that this PR extends, making them the clearest issue-family routing candidate from the inspected history.
